output.scope: Internal exact output sequence parity. Not original-HF fidelity or downstream accuracy.

work.scope: Active recurrent rows, not padded physical GEMM work.

lifetime.scope: Recorded native ACK precedes source retirement. Both coordinator credits retire and final native KV allocations are empty. This is not GPU DMA timing or HF fidelity.

frozen_SLO.rule: Two times serial calibration percentiles. Use the tighter per-metric limit across Atomic and C2048. Freeze before held-out pilot serving.

metrics.scope: Clean finite pilot. Host request latencies, not exclusive GPU durations or sustainable capacity.
metrics.name: i_huginn_heavy_token_dynamic_start1_128
metrics.arrival_rate_scope: The retained realized_arrival_QPS field measures the finite scheduled trace. actual_submit_QPS measures actual coordinator send starts. Neither is completed throughput.
metrics.service_start_evidence: Native model-stream entry CUDA event after input preparation
metrics.service_start_limit: Not a CUPTI first-kernel timestamp. Clock uncertainty is retained per request.
metrics.timing_scope: Device enclosures include launch gaps and possibly other requests. They are not exclusive GPU kernel times.

accounting.scope: Completion is paired with actual accepted boundaries. Full-depth execution still requires the separate work gate. Native-streaming payloads are not zero when snapshot records are absent.

output.scope: Internal exact output sequence parity. Not original-HF fidelity or downstream accuracy.

work.scope: Active recurrent rows, not padded physical GEMM work.

lifetime.scope: Recorded native ACK precedes source retirement. Both coordinator credits retire and final native KV allocations are empty. This is not GPU DMA timing or HF fidelity.

frozen_SLO.rule: Two times serial calibration percentiles. Use the tighter per-metric limit across Atomic and C2048. Freeze before held-out pilot serving.

metrics.scope: Clean finite pilot. Host request latencies, not exclusive GPU durations or sustainable capacity.
metrics.name: i_huginn_heavy_loop_dynamic_start1_128
metrics.arrival_rate_scope: The retained realized_arrival_QPS field measures the finite scheduled trace. actual_submit_QPS measures actual coordinator send starts. Neither is completed throughput.
metrics.service_start_evidence: Native model-stream entry CUDA event after input preparation
metrics.service_start_limit: Not a CUPTI first-kernel timestamp. Clock uncertainty is retained per request.
metrics.timing_scope: Device enclosures include launch gaps and possibly other requests. They are not exclusive GPU kernel times.

output.scope: Internal exact output sequence parity. Not original-HF fidelity or downstream accuracy.

work.scope: Active recurrent rows, not padded physical GEMM work.

lifetime.scope: Recorded native ACK precedes source retirement. Both coordinator credits retire and final native KV allocations are empty. This is not GPU DMA timing or HF fidelity.

metrics.scope: Clean finite pilot. Host request latencies, not exclusive GPU durations or sustainable capacity.

accounting.scope: Completion is paired with actual accepted boundaries. Full-depth execution still requires the separate work gate. Native-streaming payloads are not zero when snapshot records are absent.

output.scope: Internal exact output sequence parity. Not original-HF fidelity or downstream accuracy.

work.scope: Active recurrent rows, not padded physical GEMM work.

lifetime.scope: Recorded native ACK precedes source retirement. Both coordinator credits retire and final native KV allocations are empty. This is not GPU DMA timing or HF fidelity.

frozen_SLO.rule: Two times serial calibration percentiles. Use the tighter per-metric limit across Atomic and C2048. Freeze before held-out pilot serving.

metrics.scope: Clean finite pilot. Host request latencies, not exclusive GPU durations or sustainable capacity.

accounting.scope: Completion is paired with actual accepted boundaries. Full-depth execution still requires the separate work gate. Native-streaming payloads are not zero when snapshot records are absent.

output.scope: Internal exact output sequence parity. Not original-HF fidelity or downstream accuracy.

work.scope: Active recurrent rows, not padded physical GEMM work.

lifetime.scope: Recorded native ACK precedes source retirement. Both coordinator credits retire and final native KV allocations are empty. This is not GPU DMA timing or HF fidelity.

frozen_SLO.rule: 2x independent serial-calibration p95 request latency; 2x token ITL p99.

metrics.scope: Clean finite pilot. Host request latencies, not exclusive GPU durations or sustainable capacity.
metrics.name: i_ouro_low_token_dynamic_start1_128
metrics.arrival_rate_scope: The retained realized_arrival_QPS field measures the finite scheduled trace. actual_submit_QPS measures actual coordinator send starts. Neither is completed throughput.
metrics.service_start_evidence: Native model-stream entry CUDA event after input preparation
metrics.service_start_limit: Not a CUPTI first-kernel timestamp. Clock uncertainty is retained per request.
metrics.timing_scope: Device enclosures include launch gaps and possibly other requests. They are not exclusive GPU kernel times.

accounting.name: i_ouro_low_token_dynamic_start1_128
accounting.transport_time_scope: Cumulative host-observed completion age. Not pure GPU DMA time or an exclusive E2E component.
accounting.submission_scope: Native model-runner submissions, not CUDA kernel or GEMM invocation counts.
